purpose: Test connecting the seven IQP triples, and assess learning-rate-tuned MLP size scaling up to approximately the connected IQP parameter budget.
connected_circuit: Preserve the 21-qubit neural encoder, seven intra-triple IQP blocks and binary global majority; add six independently trainable RZZ gates joining qubit 3j to 3j+1 for j=1,...,6 in one-based indexing. Bridge angles start independently Normal(0,0.5^2), with a separate generator seeded by seed+900000. Existing parameters have exactly the disconnected model's initialization. Total 139 parameters.
simulation_scope: Connected chain of constant-size blocks; generically entangled across the former block boundaries. Exact tensor-network contraction remains polynomial for this bounded-width chain. No classical hardness claim.
mlp_architecture: Linear(4,h), Tanh, Linear(h,2), with softmax actions. Default Torch initialization, all parameters trained.
development_amendment: Before locking selection or running any test seeds, extend the development grid with learning rate 0.1 to include a larger-rate alternative. Earlier development jobs at the three initial rates continue unchanged; the added rate is evaluated on the same eight development seeds.
selection: For each MLP width select highest mean development AUC, tie-break by fewer restricted solve episodes then lower learning rate. Before test, lock the selected learning rate for all eight widths and designate the best-AUC MLP. Additionally select the fastest-convergence configuration across the FULL development grid, tie-break by higher AUC then smaller width and lower learning rate; test this additional configuration if not already selected for its width. Do not select the reported winner from test means alone.
iqp_selection: Connected bridge initialization and IQP learning rate 0.03 are fixed, without bridge-strength or architecture search in this study. Evaluate disconnected IQP as a same-initialization control.
training: 500 episodes capped at 200 steps; REINFORCE gamma .99, Adam AMSGrad, five-episode updates, EMA baseline .05, normalized batch advantages, entropy .005, gradient norm clip 1. Neural preprocessing unchanged. Freeze only after a full trailing 100-episode mean >=195, checked at update boundaries. All models use the corrected rule.
evaluation: 100 fresh frozen-policy evaluation episodes per test run. Same seed mapping as previous experiments. Keep all raw runs, including failures. Initial-policy audit on test cohort after selection, not used for tuning.
primary_metrics: Normalized 500-episode training-return AUC and restricted first episode at which the full rolling-100 return mean >=195 (501 if not reached). Learning speed means episode/sample efficiency, not wall-clock runtime.
inference: Paired bootstrap intervals and exact two-sided paired sign-randomization tests. Holm adjust all IQP-vs-MLP primary tests: eight width-selected configurations plus the fastest-convergence configuration if distinct, times two endpoints. Report designated development-selected winners, matched-width baseline, and full size curve. Also report paired connected-vs-disconnected comparison separately as exploratory.
saturation: Do not infer saturation from a nonsignificant difference alone. Compare width 19 with widths 9,12,16 using paired bootstrap intervals, and assess practical equivalence against margins 0.02 normalized AUC and 25 restricted solve episodes. Use conservative 98.3333% intervals across these three size contrasts; report inconclusive if intervals do not establish equivalence. These margins are specified before collecting data.
caveats: Finite architecture and learning-rate grid, one task, different initialization priors, prior IQP architecture selection. No claim of the best possible classical policy, universal saturation, or quantum advantage. Paper unchanged.
